mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.tenants (id, tenant_key, name, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_default, tenant_mode_origin) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantKey}, #{name}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{isDefault}, #{tenantModeOrigin}) ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING
mapper.select:
SELECT id, tenant_key, name, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_default, tenant_mode_origin FROM public.tenants
( LOWER(name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')) OR LOWER(tenant_key) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')) )
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY
name tenant_key updated_at created_at
ASC DESC
, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenants WHERE name = #{name})
SELECT id, tenant_key, name, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_default, tenant_mode_origin FROM public.tenants WHERE status = 'PROVISIONING' AND created_at < #{olderThan}

SELECT u.email AS email, u.first_name AS firstName FROM public.tenants t JOIN public.tenant_memberships m ON m.tenant_key = t.tenant_key JOIN public.tenant_member_authorities a ON a.membership_id = m.id JOIN public.users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE t.tenant_key = #{tenantKey} AND a.authority = 'TENANT_OWNER' LIMIT 1
SELECT id, tenant_key, name, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_default, tenant_mode_origin FROM public.tenants WHERE is_default = true LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE public.tenants SET is_default = true, updated_at = NOW() WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.tenants (id, tenant_key, name, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_default, tenant_mode_origin) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantKey}, #{name}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, true, #{tenantModeOrigin}) ON CONFLICT (is_default) WHERE is_default = true DO NOTHING
